answer: Open the guild book, count the winters, and the farm's story falls apart. A farm of 342 pays 46854 POA to enter and 5814 minutes to stay, while one agent pays once and is done. I would rather trust one Accredited fresco painter intonaco record with trade council attestation than a hundred promises, since it is earned by 4-year apprenticeship, 168 supervised frescoes, theory exam, guild dues. Take the lagoon to the master who signed it, take the zephyr to the coffer it came from, and take the delta to the year it was filed, and the farm's story ends there.
